**Learn more:** [Data System](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/controls/data-system), [Async Resources](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/async-resources)

## Types [#types]

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Async values](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/async-values) | The value a resource hook returns while it loads, after it loads and after it fails. |
| [Column attributes](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/column-attributes) | Attributes that change how a property shows as a column. |
| [Enums](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/enums) | The enumerations in this category. |
| [Paging](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/paging) | Types for infinite and paged resources. |
| [Query cache](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/query-cache) | The process-wide cache that resource hooks share. |
| [Sort and filter descriptors](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/descriptors) | Requests, sort, filter and field descriptors that data sources receive. |
| [`FocusRevalidationService`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/FocusRevalidationService) | Central service that invalidates stale `QueryCache` entries when the app window is reactivated or resumed, so consumers that opted in via `ResourceOptions.RefetchOnWindowFocus = true` see fresh data after an Alt-Tab or resume. |
| [`IDataSource<T>`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/IDataSource) | A read-only data source that provides paged access to items. |
| [`IKeyedDataSource<T>`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/IKeyedDataSource) | A data source that supports fetching individual items by key. |
| [`IMutableDataSource<T>`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/IMutableDataSource) | A mutable data source that supports CRUD operations. |
| [`IObservableDataSource<T>`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/IObservableDataSource) | A data source that fires events when data changes. |
| [`ListDataSource<T>`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/ListDataSource) | In-memory data source backed by a list. |
| [`ObservableListDataSource<T>`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/data/ObservableListDataSource) | An observable data source that watches an ObservableCollection for changes and fires DataChanged when items are added, removed, or modified. |
